<a name="Canonical"></a>
## func [Canonical](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/manifest/manifest.go#L42>)

```go
func Canonical(m contract.Manifest) ([]byte, error)
```

Canonical mengubah m ke JSON satu baris tanpa spasi dengan urutan field schema, package, version, algorithm, keyid, artifact \(name, size, sha256\). Gagal kalau m tidak valid atau hasilnya lebih dari 16 KiB.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>



```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"kelompok17/internal/contract"
	"kelompok17/internal/manifest"
)

var m = contract.Manifest{
	Schema:    contract.ManifestSchema,
	Package:   "demo",
	Version:   "1.0.0",
	Algorithm: "ed25519",
	KeyID:     strings.Repeat("ab", 32),
	Artifact: contract.Artifact{
		Name:   "hello.txt",
		Size:   5,
		SHA256: "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824",
	},
}

func main() {
	out, _ := manifest.Canonical(m)
	fmt.Println(string(out))
}
```

#### Output

```
{"schema":"minisign-manifest/v1","package":"demo","version":"1.0.0","algorithm":"ed25519","keyid":"abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab","artifact":{"name":"hello.txt","size":5,"sha256":"2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824"}}
```

</p>
</details>

<a name="Parse"></a>
## func [Parse](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/manifest/manifest.go#L57>)

```go
func Parse(data []byte) (contract.Manifest, error)
```

Parse mem\-parse data lalu membandingkannya byte per byte dengan hasil Canonical. Gagal kalau data lebih dari 16 KiB, JSON\-nya ditolak strictjson, ada field yang tidak valid, atau data tidak canonical.

<details><summary>Example</summary>
<p>



```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"kelompok17/internal/contract"
	"kelompok17/internal/manifest"
)

var m = contract.Manifest{
	Schema:    contract.ManifestSchema,
	Package:   "demo",
	Version:   "1.0.0",
	Algorithm: "ed25519",
	KeyID:     strings.Repeat("ab", 32),
	Artifact: contract.Artifact{
		Name:   "hello.txt",
		Size:   5,
		SHA256: "2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824",
	},
}

func main() {
	canonical, _ := manifest.Canonical(m)
	_, err := manifest.Parse(canonical)
	fmt.Println(err)
	spaced := bytes.Replace(canonical, []byte(`,"package"`), []byte(`, "package"`), 1)
	_, err = manifest.Parse(spaced)
	fmt.Println(err)
}
```

#### Output

```
<nil>
manifest: not in canonical form
```

</p>
</details>

<a name="Validate"></a>
## func [Validate](<https://github.com/sbimasena/Tugas3_IF4020_17/blob/main/internal/manifest/manifest.go#L26>)

```go
func Validate(m contract.Manifest) error
```

Validate mengecek semua field m sesuai aturan di contract.Manifest. Nilai Algorithm tidak dicek, hanya dipastikan bisa di\-escape.
